notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-4, review report (EY) p.5. Units differ: the SCI (p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, no other revenue line. Revenue and expenses from note 3 (p.15, 3 months, both years). CSM roll-forward 4.2 p.18 (3 months); future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment relating to future service (CSM column); accretion = the profit-or-loss part of the insurance finance row (CSM column). New business 4.3 p.20. The tax line 'income (expense)' is a credit this quarter (190,497 Baht), kept positive. RA release uses note 3 (2,948), not the AOC RA (4,468). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses + other expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
